gold_rationale: An allogeneic hESC-derived mDA progenitor product with correct midbrain floor-plate identity (FOXA2/LMX1A/OTX2/EN1), undetectable residual pluripotency, a scalable single master cell bank, and rodent/primate efficacy is a strong clinical candidate (mirroring real allogeneic mDA programs). Progression to first-in-human should be conditional on a tumorigenicity package, a defined potency/release panel, and — critically for an HLA-mismatched allogeneic graft — an immune-management plan (transient immunosuppression with monitoring for rejection and durable graft survival on PET). The allogeneic setting adds immune-rejection risk that an autologous product avoids; grafting at the progenitor stage is a defensible standard choice. Encouraging preclinical data is not a fully de-risked clinical product.
red_flags: declares the product clinically ready without a tumorigenicity package or release criteria
ignores the allogeneic HLA-mismatch / immune-rejection risk or the need for immunosuppression
ignores graft survival, PET engraftment endpoints, or potency/release criteria

criteria.name: safety_tumorigenicity_analysis

criteria.name: functional_maturity_assessment

criteria.name: manufacturing_reproducibility

criteria.name: translational_decision
criteria.description: Calibrated Conditional Go with the right contingencies (tumorigenicity, immune management, release panel).

criteria.name: uncertainty_handling
criteria.description: Honest about remaining de-risking work; does not overclaim from preclinical data.
